assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
Every task uses the AIRBYTE_SERVER integration
Every task runs the AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB job
job_type only ever takes a valid Airbyte job type (sync or reset)
job_type is specified on the Airbyte task(s)
No host or port value is written as a literal task parameter — the self-hosted host/port belongs on the Orchestra Airbyte Server connection, not duplicated as a parameter
